title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Several Opinions on Further Strengthening and Promoting the Work of People's Assessors
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice of Issuing the Several Opinions on Further Strengthening and Promoting the Work of People's Jurors

Fa Fa [2010] No. 24

Higher People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

The Several Opinions on Further Strengthening and Promoting the Work of People's Jurors are hereby issued to you. Please earnestly implement them in light of the actual work situation.

June 29, 2010

Several Opinions on Further Strengthening and Promoting the Work of People's Jurors

In order to thoroughly implement the Decision of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on Improving the System of People's Jurors (hereinafter referred to as the "Decision"), further strengthen and promote the work of people's jurors, continuously improve the system of people's jurors, and give full play to the important role of the people's courts in deeply advancing the three key tasks of resolving social conflicts, innovating social management, and ensuring fair and honest law enforcement, in accordance with the Decision and relevant documents, and in light of the actual work of people's jurors, the following opinions are put forward for strengthening and promoting the work of people's jurors in the coming period.

I. Continuously Deepen Understanding and Comprehensively Strengthen the Work of People's Jurors

1. Strengthening and promoting the work of people's jurors is conducive to improving the socialist judicial system and promoting judicial democracy. The implementation of the system of people's jurors is an important and direct form for the people to participate in the management of state affairs in the judicial field in accordance with the law. It is an important part of improving the socialist democratic political system, an important manifestation of socialist judicial democracy in our country, and a concrete embodiment of the mass line of our Party in the work of the people's judiciary. A deep understanding of the positive significance of the system of people's jurors, giving full play to the unique advantages of the vast number of people's jurors in the judicial trial field, such as connecting with the masses, being familiar with the masses, and representing the masses, allowing ordinary citizens to assist in the judiciary, witness the judiciary, and manage the judiciary, fully reflecting the democratic function of the judiciary, can more centrally access the people's sentiments, reflect public opinion, gather the people's wisdom, and achieve people's democracy to a greater extent.

2. Strengthening and promoting the work of people's jurors is conducive to ensuring judicial fairness and integrity. People's jurors participating in the trial of cases focus on analyzing and judging cases from the perspective of social moral standards, thereby effectively achieving the complementarity of popular thinking and judges' professional thinking; the perspective of the masses, different professional backgrounds and expertise of people's jurors are conducive to finding out the facts of the case, correctly applying the law, and ensuring impartial adjudication. People's jurors have the advantage of knowing the people's sentiments and understanding public opinion, and they interpret the law in a language that is familiar and understandable to the masses, which is conducive to persuading the parties to make mutual concessions, settle disputes, and further improve the quality and efficiency of case handling. People's jurors come from all walks of life; their participation in trials increases the transparency of trial activities, promotes judicial openness, is conducive to further strengthening and giving play to the role of mutual supervision and mutual restraint among members of the collegiate bench, jointly resisting various illegal interventions, and helping the people's courts to exercise their adjudicative power in accordance with the law, independently, and fairly.

3. Strengthening and promoting the work of people's jurors is conducive to enhancing judicial authority. Implementing the system of people's jurors and adhering to the mass line in judicial work makes judicial activities closer to social life, closer to the people, and closer to the requirements of the times. This is an effective way for the people to directly experience judicial fairness and for the judiciary to approach the people. It is conducive to all sectors of society objectively understanding the true situation of court work, reducing and eliminating possible misunderstandings in society about court trials, and further enhancing the judicial authority of the people's courts, thereby better achieving the organic unity of the legal effect and social effect of case adjudication.

II. Broaden the Scope of Selection and Strict Appointment and Removal Procedures

4. Each basic people's court shall, based on factors such as the number and characteristics of cases in its jurisdiction, population size, geographical area, ethnic composition, and the need to meet the requirements of higher people's courts for randomly selecting people's jurors from that court, select a number of people's jurors not less than half of the number of current judges in that court, and, subject to the availability of funds and training conditions, appropriately increase the number of people's jurors selected, and promptly submit them to the standing committee of the people's congress at the same level for appointment.

5. The selection of people's jurors shall generally be conducted once every five years. However, additional people's jurors may be appropriately added in accordance with legal procedures based on the needs of local trial work. A basic people's court conducting additional selections shall promptly report the additional selection work to the higher people's court level by level for record.

6. Each basic people's court shall establish an information database for people's jurors and candidates, and classify them into different categories based on factors such as their area, industry, and expertise, to meet the needs of the jury work.

7. In the selection of people's jurors, attention shall be paid to the structural proportion of personnel from all sectors of society, and efforts shall be made to include people from different industries, different occupations, different ages, different ethnic groups, and different genders, to reflect the breadth and representativeness of their sources.

8. Each higher people's court shall, based on the actual work situation in its jurisdiction, establish a feasible exit mechanism for people's jurors. If a person's occupation or position changes, or due to health reasons, they are unable to continue to perform jury duties, the people's court shall, in accordance with legal procedures, submit a request to the standing committee of the people's congress at the same level to remove the person from the position of people's juror.

9. If a people's juror, without justifiable reasons, refuses to participate in jury trials more than three times within a three-year period, they shall be deemed to have resigned. The people's court shall handle the relevant procedures in accordance with the procedures.

III. Perform Duties in Accordance with the Law, Effectively Guarantee Rights

10. In cases that shall be tried with the participation of people's jurors in accordance with the law, the people's court must arrange for people's jurors and judges to form a collegial bench for trial. The parties may not refuse without legal justification.

11. If a criminal defendant in a first-instance criminal case, a plaintiff or defendant in a civil or commercial case, or a plaintiff in an administrative case requests that a people's juror participate in the collegial bench trial, the people's court shall arrange for people's jurors and judges to form a collegial bench for trial.

If the people's court, after obtaining the consent of the parties specified in the preceding paragraph for the collegial bench composed of people's jurors and judges to try the case, it shall be deemed a request.

12. If one party requests the application of the jury system and the other party does not agree, the people's court shall not arrange for people's jurors to participate in the collegial bench trial, except for cases that shall apply the jury system as provided by law.

13. The people's court shall provide work facilities and conditions for people's jurors to consult case files and participate in trial activities. A people's juror who receives a jury notice shall complete the review of the case file before the case is opened in court.

14. The presiding judge shall guide and ensure that people's jurors exercise their rights in accordance with the law. During the trial of a case, with the consent of the presiding judge, a people's juror may participate in the joint investigation of the case, directly ask questions during the court session, and independently conduct mediation in the case.

15. The collegial bench shall ensure the right of people's jurors to express their opinions independently and autonomously during the deliberation of the case. The presiding judge and other members of the collegial bench shall not exert undue influence or obstruction.

16. If a people's juror disagrees with the opinions of other members of the collegial bench, their opinion shall be recorded in the minutes. When necessary, the people's juror may request that the collegial bench submit the case to the president for a decision on whether to submit it to the adjudication committee for discussion, but reasons shall be provided. The request and reasons raised by the people's juror shall be recorded in the deliberation minutes.

17. When a people's juror is invited to attend the meeting of the adjudication committee to discuss the case in which they served as a juror, they may express opinions at the adjudication committee, except that they shall not exercise the right to vote.

IV. Improve the Random Selection Mechanism, Standardize Jury Work Procedures

18. Each basic people's court shall, with the goal of being scientific, standardized, and easy to operate, further improve the work system and guarantee mechanism for randomly selecting people's jurors to participate in case trials, ensuring the implementation of the principles of breadth and mass participation in the Decision regarding the work of people's jurors.

19. People's jurors participating in case trials shall be determined by random selection. The people's court shall, before the opening of the court session, determine the people's jurors by random selection from the list of people's jurors using appropriate methods. If required by the trial of the case, random selection may be conducted from among people's jurors in relevant geographical areas, industries, professions, or other categories.

20. For cases tried by intermediate people's courts and higher people's courts that shall be tried by a collegial bench with the participation of people's jurors in accordance with the law, the people's jurors shall be determined by random selection from the list of people's jurors of basic people's courts within the prefecture-level city where the court is located.

21. For cases tried by maritime courts, forestry courts, railway courts, reclamation area courts, oilfield courts, mining area courts, and development zone courts that shall be tried by a collegial bench with the participation of people's jurors in accordance with the law, the people's jurors shall be determined by random selection from the list of people's jurors of basic people's courts within the prefecture-level city where the court is located or within the case jurisdiction.

22. A people's juror who also serves as a people's mediator shall not participate in the jury trial of a case that they have previously mediated.

23. People's jurors participating in trial activities shall abide by the rules and regulations regarding judicial discipline and etiquette.

24. The challenge of a people's juror shall refer to the legal provisions on the challenge of judges.

V. Effectively Strengthen Training Work, Comprehensively Improve Jury Competence

25. Each higher people's court shall promptly propose an overall plan and implementation opinions for the training of people's jurors in its jurisdiction, and report them to the Supreme People's Court for record.

26. After appointment, people's jurors shall, in accordance with the provisions, receive pre-service training before participating in trials of cases in the people's court in accordance with the law. The content, form, and methods of pre-service training shall be designed and arranged according to the actual needs of people's jurors to participate in trial activities. Pre-service training shall mainly be undertaken by higher people's courts or intermediate people's courts authorized by them.

27. The content of pre-service training includes socialist rule of law concepts, professional ethics of judges, China's judicial system, trial discipline, judicial etiquette, integrity regulations, basic legal knowledge, and basic rules of trial work. The people's court may also arrange training content in conjunction with the characteristics and types of cases in its region.

28. The people's court shall, according to the needs of trial work, plan and organize training on political theory and newly promulgated laws, regulations, and judicial interpretations for people's jurors during their term of office. Routine on-the-job training shall mainly be undertaken by the basic people's court to which the people's juror is assigned.

29. The form and method of on-the-job training shall be determined according to the characteristics and actual conditions of the people's jurors. In addition to centralized classroom training, methods such as targeted trial observation, case-based teaching, mock demonstrations, audiovisual teaching, and mobile teaching may also be adopted, as well as organizing thematic discussions among people's jurors on hot, difficult, and key cases. On-the-job training shall not be less than 20 class hours.

VI. Strengthen Management and Assessment, Implement Funding Guarantees

30. People's courts at all levels shall, according to work needs and actual conditions, establish a people's juror work management office, responsible for formulating and implementing various management systems and specific measures for the work of people's jurors.

31. Basic people's courts shall conduct dynamic assessments of people's jurors, establish and improve assessment management systems, establish a performance file for jury work, focusing on assessing the number of jury cases, attendance rate, jury competence, trial discipline, and trial style. The integrity, self-discipline, and impartial administration of justice by people's jurors shall be included in the scope of the integrity supervision work of the basic people's court to which they belong.

32. Before the end of each year, the basic people's court to which the people's juror belongs shall notify the assessment results in writing to the people's juror themselves and their unit (or the basic-level organization of their domicile or habitual residence), and simultaneously report the relevant assessment situation to the internal affairs and judicial committee of the local people's congress at the same level and the judicial administrative organ.

33. People's jurors enjoy the same rights as the judges on the collegial bench and shall also perform the same obligations. If, during the performance of jury duties, a people's juror abuses their power, neglects their duty, or engages in favoritism or malpractice, the people's court shall, depending on the circumstances, criticize and educate them; if the circumstances are serious, they shall be removed from their position as people's juror in accordance with legal procedures, and a recommendation shall be made to their unit or basic-level organization for handling; if the act constitutes a crime, criminal liability shall be pursued in accordance with the law.

34. The necessary expenses incurred by people's jurors in participating in trial activities shall be included in the scope of case handling (business) expenses of the people's court. People's courts at all levels shall actively work with the relevant departments, such as the financial department at the same level, to jointly study and implement the contents of existing policies and regulations, increase funding input, and standardize the scope of use.

35. Each higher people's court shall study and determine the subsidy standards and methods for people's jurors in its jurisdiction participating in trial activities.

36. If a people's juror participates in trial activities of an intermediate people's court, a higher people's court, or other courts, the relevant court shall provide subsidies in accordance with the provisions.

VII. Strengthen Organizational Leadership, Ensure Implementation of Systems

37. People's courts at all levels shall list the work of people's jurors as an important agenda item, actively create favorable conditions, and take practical and effective measures to ensure the implementation of the Decision and relevant provisions of the Supreme People's Court. In implementing the system of people's jurors, people's courts at all levels shall promote it actively and steadily under the leadership of the Party committee, supervision of the people's congress, and support of the government. They shall actively and proactively report major issues and progress to the Party committee and the people's congress, and strengthen communication and coordination with the judicial administrative organs and financial departments.

38. Higher people's courts shall proactively take the initiative to help lower people's courts do more work, coordinate and urge relevant departments to effectively solve various difficulties and problems encountered in the work of people's jurors.

39. People's courts at all levels shall strengthen the publicity of the system of people's jurors, take practical and effective measures, and make extensive use of various media such as newspapers, radio, television, and the internet, give full play to the guiding role of public opinion, vigorously publicize the important significance of the system of people's jurors, summarize and publicize the experience and practices of outstanding people's jurors. They shall improve publicity methods, focus on publicizing typical cases and significant effects of people's jurors, strive for full recognition of the work of people's jurors from all sectors of society, and actively create a good atmosphere in the whole society to support people's jurors in performing their trial duties in accordance with the law and to pay attention to court trial work.
